pending.title: OPM final rule replaces seniority/tenure-protective RIF procedures with performance-based retention criteria
pending.rationale: Final OPM rule (published, not proposed) restructures reduction-in-force procedures to prioritize performance ratings over tenure and length of service, removing a longstanding seniority-based safeguard against politicized personnel decisions. This is a confirmed, executed regulatory action creating a durable mechanism for at-will-style workforce reshaping within RIF actions, distinct from the broader Schedule Policy/Career reclassification already on the ledger. Scope is targeted to RIF procedures, warranting magnitude 2.

pending.title: OPM final rule strips MSPB jurisdiction over suitability action appeals, consolidating review authority within OPM
pending.rationale: Final OPM rule removes the independent Merit Systems Protection Board from adjudicating suitability action appeals and consolidates that authority inside the executive personnel office itself. This eliminates an external check on the executive's use of suitability determinations to screen or remove federal personnel, a durable structural change confirmed via Federal Register final-rule publication. Effect is contained to suitability appeals, meriting magnitude 2 rather than higher.
